concerns.location: tasks.md:T012 vs plan.md:Constitution Check V / Project Structure
concerns.text: No task implements the plan's `code/utils/update_state.py` versioning workflow (SHA-256 hashing of data/derived and data/processed into the state YAML after each phase). T012 instead states 'Research scripts must not write to state/ or modify platform state (platform owns artifact hashing)', directly contradicting the plan element. Either a task must cover update_state.py or the plan must be amended; as written, Constitution V's declared implementing mechanism has no covering task.

No task creates or pins `requirements.txt` at `projects/PROJ-820-.../code/` (constitution: 'pins every Python dependency'). Tasks reference pytest suites and dependencies (pymunk, diffusers, ultralytics, scikit-image) but no task delivers the pinned requirements file the isolated-venv execution depends on.

The spec edge case requires that images with detection confidence <0.7 are 'flagged for manual review' in addition to being conservatively counted as violations. T006 implements only the default-to-violation rule; no task or schema field covers the manual-review flagging half of this compound requirement.

Two conflicting physics-constraint contracts exist (YAML nested schema vs flat JSON variant). T002 validates only against the YAML; no task retires, reconciles, or references the orphaned `contracts/physics_constraint.json`, leaving an implementer able to target the wrong contract.

concerns.location: tasks.md (Phase structure) vs plan.md:Project Structure tests/integration/test_pipeline.py
concerns.text: The plan's structure declares `tests/integration/test_pipeline.py` (end-to-end small run) but no task creates it; T012's manual re-run partially covers the intent, yet the declared test artifact has no covering task. Also note plan places tests at project-root `tests/` while tasks use `code/tests/` — pick one.
